instructions: Run npm run dev and navigate to /dashboard/products
Verify products load and display correctly
Test scrolling through the list (should be smooth)
Test edit functionality - click edit, verify modal opens
Test delete functionality - click delete, verify confirmation
Test visibility toggle - verify it updates immediately
Test search/filter - verify filtered list updates
Check browser DevTools: Inspect DOM, verify only ~20-30 ProductListItem elements exist regardless of total count
Test with empty list - verify empty state still shows
Test with small list (< 20 items) - verify works normally
